ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT Agreement made as of this 23 day of September, 2006, between ANJ PARTNERS LLC having an address at 242-01 Braddock Avenue, Bellerose, New York ("Grantor"), and DYLAN PARTNERS LLC ("Developer"), a New York limited liability company,having an address at 242-01 Braddock Avenue,Bellerose,New York 11426. WHEREAS, Grantor is the owner of certain land in the City of New York and County of Bronx, with all improvements thereon, known as (no #) 149" Street, designated as Block 2580,Lot 22 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the“Tax Map"), and being more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto (said land together with any and all improvements now or hereafter existing thereon being herein called"Parcel A"); and WHEREAS,Developer owns certain land in the City of NewYork and County of Bronx, with all improvements thereon, known as 532 Concord Avenue, Bronx, New York designated an Block 2580, Lot 11 on the Tax Map, and being more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto (said land together with any and all improvements now or hereafter existing thereon being herein referred to as “Parcel B"); and WHEREAS, the Grantor desires to convey and the Developer desires to acquire the Excess Development rights (as hereinafter defined); and Building")upon all or a portion of Parcel Bwhich will contain or use more floor area and development rights than are now available for use on Parcel B pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the purpose of transferring to Parcel B all of the Excess Development Rights appurtenant to Parcel A and Grantor is willing to transfer such portion of the Excess Development Rights to Parcel B in perpetuity; and WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") comprised of Parcel A and Parcel B; and WHEREAS, Developer reserves the right at or prior to Closing to expand or diminish the properties included in “Parcel B", whether by the addition or exclusion of other fee parcels or by the addition or exclusion of other parcels, excess development rights which have been or will be acquired by Developer, in which case the description 1

and definitions of Parcel B will be modified appropriately; and WHEREAS,the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW,THEREFORE,in consideration of the premises and the mutual covenants hereinafter contained, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1.As used herein: "Zoning Resolution"' shall mean The Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “City"), effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time. "Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean all of the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, which are appurtenant to a zoning lot, to develop such zoning lot by erecting thereon a structure or structures with a total floor area determined by (i) multiplying the area of the zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which the zoning lot is located, and (i) by the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution and which may be authorized to be developed by the City Planning Commission (the “Planning Commission") or other appropriate agency of the City of NewYork. "Excess Development Rights" shall mean six thousand five hundred (6,500) square feet of the Floor Area Development Rights which are appurtenant to the zoning lot in whichParcel A is located. and “Bulk" shall have the meaning set forth in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution. "Remaining Development Rights" shall mean those Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the zoning lot in which Parcel A is located less the Excess FloorAreaRights.  2. A.  If the New York City Department of Buildings determines that a light and air easement is required over Parcel A, the Grantor shall promptly execute, acknowledge and deliver a separate instrument granting such easement in such form as is required by the Department of Buildings. B.
